history.text: Asparuh founded the First Bulgarian Empire south of the Danube.
The Asen brothers' revolt restored Bulgarian rule from Tarnovo.
The Treaty of Berlin created an autonomous Bulgarian principality.
Bulgaria became independent from the Ottoman Empire, marking a key step in modern statehood.
The monarchy was abolished, changing Bulgaria's form of government.
One-party rule ended and Bulgaria adopted its present republican form.
